description: Helps you decide what your customer interviews mean for your ICP. You give structured notes, one per interview: the customer, the role, pain points, buying triggers, value realized and key quotes. You get the pain points, objections, buying triggers, value realized and champion roles across the interviews, quotes kept word for word, discovery questions and sector notes. It does not take full transcripts; give only the points and quotes you want analyzed. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Without interview_notes, it returns the structured-notes format to supply. Invalid typed values return a correction error. Use this instead of customer_interview_kit when you already have structured interview notes to analyze.

company.description: Optional: your company or product name, so the answer can name it. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

interview_notes.description: Structured interview notes: one object per interview with the customer (company or segment), the role of the person interviewed and the points and quotes to analyze. Format is a JSON array. For example, [{"customer":"an approved anonymous manufacturer","role":"finance director","key_quotes":["Approval handoffs take too long."]}].

items.description: Format is a JSON object. For example, {"customer":"an approved anonymous manufacturer","role":"finance director","key_quotes":["Approval handoffs take too long."]}.

buying_triggers.description: Format is a JSON array. For example, ["upcoming audit"].

items.description: Format is text. For example, "upcoming audit".

customer.description: Format is text. For example, "an approved anonymous manufacturer".

key_quotes.description: Format is a JSON array. For example, ["Approval handoffs take too long."].

items.description: Format is text. For example, "Approval handoffs take too long.".

pain_points.description: Format is a JSON array. For example, ["invoice exceptions delay close"].

items.description: Format is text. For example, "invoice exceptions delay close".

role.description: Format is text. For example, "finance director".

value_realized.description: Format is a JSON array. For example, ["200 to 500 employees"].

items.description: Format is text. For example, "200 to 500 employees".

product_category.description: Optional: what you sell, used for sector notes. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

name: icp_interview_synthesizer
title: ICP Interview Synthesizer
